records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Revenue: Total fiscal 2021 revenue was $21.3 billion, an increase of 24 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The acquisition of Tableau in August 2019 contributed approximately $1.5 billion and $652 million to total subscription and support revenues in fiscal 2021 and fiscal 2020, respectively, and is included in the above amounts.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In addition, fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates had a modest favorable impact on both our remaining performance obligation and current remaining performance obligation as of January 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result of our aggressive growth plans and integration of our previously acquired businesses, we have incurred significant expenses for equity awards and amortization of purchased intangibles, which have reduced our operating income.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For example, changes in billing frequency for new business and investments in our go-to-market efforts resulted in a negative impact to our operating cash flows during the year.
